narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -3.45 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.01592-0.01619 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.01631; the first objective pays 0.31R at 0.01583.

plan.triggerRule: footprint sdiv fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.01631 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
